2607.14975.title: CFM-Bench: A Unified Multi-Domain, Multi-Task Benchmark for Channel Foundation Models
2607.14975.paper_summary: Channel foundation models (CFMs) are developing rapidly, with recent studies reporting benefits from pretraining across downstream wireless tasks. Yet CFMs are commonly evaluated in model-specific pipelines with different data, radio configurations, partitions, adaptation procedures, task definitions, and metrics. Reported comparisons therefore tend to show that pretraining improves over supervised training from scratch within one pipeline, but neither rank CFMs nor compare them fairly with task-specific models. We release CFM-Bench, a unified multi-domain, multi-task benchmark designed to address this gap. It curates six channel configurations spanning 3GPP statistical simulation, two independent ray-tracing pipelines, industrial and aerial measurements, and synchronized vehicular multimodal simulation. Official partitions isolate complete trajectories, measurement sessions, vehicle links, simulation realizations, or buffered spatial regions. CFM-Bench does not prescribe an external pretraining corpus or strategy; no benchmark split may be used for foundation-model pretraining, and the official training split is reserved exclusively for downstream fine-tuning. The benchmark additionally requires disclosure of all data used during model development and prohibits training-stage use of official test units. Six task groups are organized along three CFM application dimensions: physical-layer (PHY) channel intelligence, radio-access-network (RAN) decision intelligence, and integrated sensing and communication (ISAC). They cover CSI feedback, frequency and temporal channel extrapolation, propagation-state classification, current- and future-beam prediction, and single-frame and temporal localization. CFM-Bench provides a common substrate for comparing the transferability of channel representations across models, domains, and tasks.
2607.14975.paper_summary_zh: 頻道基礎模型（CFMs）正在迅速發展，最近的研究報告顯示在下游無線任務中，預訓練帶來了好處。<lb/>然而，CFMs 通常在特定於模型的流程中進行評估，使用不同的數據、無線電配置、劃分、適應程序、任務定義和指標。因此，報告的比較往往顯示預訓練在一個流程中優於從頭開始的監督訓練，但既未對 CFMs 進行排名，也未能公平地與特定任務模型進行比較。<lb/>我們發布了 CFM-Bench，一個統一的多領域、多任務基準，旨在填補這一空白。<lb/>它策劃了六種頻道配置，涵蓋了 3GPP 統計模擬、兩個獨立的光線追蹤流程、工業和空中測量，以及同步的車輛多模擬。<lb/>官方劃分隔離了完整的軌跡、測量會話、車輛鏈接、模擬實現或緩衝的空間區域。<lb/>CFM-Bench 不規定外部預訓練語料庫或策略；任何基準劃分均不得用於基礎模型的預訓練，官方訓練劃分專門保留用於下游微調。<lb/>該基準還要求披露在模型開發過程中使用的所有數據，並禁止在訓練階段使用官方測試單元。<lb/>六個任務組按照三個 CFM 應用維度進行組織：物理層（PHY）頻道智能、無線接入網（RAN）決策智能，以及集成感知和通信（ISAC）。<lb/>它們涵蓋了 CSI 反饋、頻率和時間頻道外推、傳播狀態分類、當前和未來波束預測，以及單幀和時間定位。<lb/>CFM-Bench 提供了一個共同的基礎，用於比較不同模型、領域和任務之間頻道表示的可轉移性。
